## What to fix

<details>
<summary>Q4 solution (spoiler)</summary>

```python
from collections import Counter


def count_pairs(a: list[int]) -> int:
    rev = lambda x: int(str(x)[::-1])
    counts = Counter(x - rev(x) for x in a)
    return sum(c * (c - 1) // 2 for c in counts.values())
```

</details>
